marco: Quick one - while updating the Rate Limits & Billing Tiers doc I spotted a few items that should land together. Can we bundle into a single PR?
anya: list them out and we'll split work.
marco: 1) error payload examples still only show `retry_after` (s). Runtime now sets `retry_after_ms` — show both and recommend `retry_after_ms`.
marco: 2) quota wording uses "tokens" in some places and "billing units" in others. Add a tiny conversion table and a migration note for old customers.
marco: 3) dashboard link points to an old path; change to the canonical console URL and call out the "Billing Viewer" role requirement.
support-lead: Support asks for a short SDK snippet demonstrating ms fallback. That cuts down on backoff-related tickets.
sdk-eng: I got JS/Python snippets ready:```js
// prefer retry_after_ms (ms), fallback to retry_after (s)
const body = await resp.json();
const waitMs = body.retry_after_ms ?? (body.retry_after ? body.retry_after * 1000 : null);
if (waitMs) await sleep(waitMs);
``````py
body = resp.json()
wait_ms = body.get('retry_after_ms') or (body.get('retry_after') and body['retry_after'] * 1000)
if wait_ms:
    time.sleep(wait_ms / 1000)
```
link-bot: Link-checker: one redirect found (docs -> /usage/overview). Use https://console.redwood.ai/usage/billing/tiers instead.
anya: I'll do the wording + conversion table (short table: gen tokens -> billing units = tokens * 1, embeddings = vectors / 1000 units).
marco: Great. I'll open a consolidated PR with three commits (errors + snippets + tests; billing units; link + screenshot). PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/733
docs-bot: CI: please add snippet-tests for the new examples.
sdk-eng: will add tests and mark for review. Targeting merge before next docs patch.
support-lead: once merged I'll update the curated support KB and notify CS.
marco: thanks — tagging reviewers @anya @sdk-eng. Closing the loop here.
